title: Island organisations, addresses, contacts and what each might publish
organisation: Straddie Noticeboard Network, and through it the organisations it names
about: Island organisations as the noticeboard network researched them. Only the entities carrying a researched profile with sources become records. Individuals are excluded whole. The rest are the wanted list: real organisations nobody has asked yet.

source_statement.quote: All entity feed ideas are hypothesised from research notes and require direct approval before public use.

cadence.run_by: whoever is maintaining the noticeboard network
cadence.reason: Addresses and phone numbers move a few times a year. The reason to run it monthly is not that the data changes that fast, it is that the wanted list needs a person looking at it often enough to actually go and ask somebody.

counts.excluded_individuals_note: The test that decides this errs toward leaving an entity out. Four trading names in the source read as personal names to it and are not on the wanted list because of that. No record is built from this test: records come only from entities carrying a researched business profile.

confidence_scale.high: Not used by this connector. This is a research repository citing operator websites, so nothing here has been read at first hand and nothing here is high.
confidence_scale.medium: The source recorded where it read this and quoted what it read. Good enough to act on, and always shown with the date it was synced.
confidence_scale.low: The source recorded no URL at all. Held rather than carried.

freshness_rule: An address moves rarely and a phone number moves sometimes, so 60 days is generous. Hours are not carried at all, at any age, because the source does not have them.

wanted.what: Opening hours, from the operators. Not one organisation in the source repository carries confirmed hours, and several say in their own words that hours need confirming before publishing.
wanted.why_it_matters: Of the 40 organisations this feed can match to data/businesses.json, 12 have hours the business published itself, 3 have hours a directory published, and 24 are still opening and closing on an estimate. An estimate is a modelling pattern and it is never shown to a player as a fact, which means the twin cannot currently tell anybody whether the bakery is open on a Tuesday in June.
wanted.who_would_have_to_agree: Each operator, one at a time.
wanted.how_small_it_could_start: One line per business: the days it opens, the hours, and the date it was said. The twin shows the date beside the hours, always, and says which of the three bases it rests on.

privacy.rule: Named private individuals and personal contact details are not committed to this repository.
privacy.applied: 10 August 2026, before the repository was made public.
privacy.note: A source organisation may be named. A private person may not, even where a public noticeboard named them. Where a feed would need one person to agree, that is recorded as a role rather than a name.
